Without another moment’s hesitation, she marched across the field to reach them.
k_p40: The three tensed up and looked at her as she approached. She stopped before them, smiling proudly up at them.
k_p41: ??? : I must commend all three of you for coming at such a time! I had not heard of any reinforcements meeting us out here!
k_p42: ??? : Tell me, are you from the capital?
k_p43_note: Ritsuka answered. He didn’t really wanna give out too much so he decided to just be a little honest.
k_p44: Ritsuka : We’re travelers that were passing by until we saw the battle taking place.
k_p46: Sora : Yeah. We’re just glad you and your men are okay.
k_p47_note: The woman exclaimed, drawing odd looks from them that she completely missed, as her smile widened.
k_p48: ??? : Then that only makes your actions all the more incredible! For you to lend us your aid without knowing us is nothing short of heroic! Therefore I must ask you to accompany me back to the capital! I shall see your efforts be rewarded no matter how long it takes!
k_p49: Sora : Oh no. You don’t have to do–
k_p49_note: Sora tried to tell her that there was no need for her to reward them for saving them.
k_p51: ??? : I have to show you my gratitude after all!
k_p51_note: Yet her happy mood seemed to quickly fade, as a more grim expression crossed her visage.
k_p52_note: She turned around and walked away, heading towards the chariots.
k_p53: ??? : I’m afraid I have another duty to attend to.
k_p54: The Chaldean Trio already understood what that meant. With the battle over, the aftermath was already in their face. The fallen bodies of the woman’s comrades who perished. Bodies that seconds prior had been full of life, and now snuffed out as easily as one would put out a candle’s flame. People died in war, that much was apparent.
k_p55_note: Ritsuka said mournfully, watching as the men went to grab their fallen allies and placed them in the chariots with the woman in red talking to one of her men.
k_p56: Mash : I know. I can’t believe Roman soldiers are fighting each other like this.
k_p56_note: Mash said in a sorrowful tone.
k_p57: Sora : Those soldiers we fought. They had to be the work of a Servant that was summoned here.
k_p57_note: Sora said, turning to watch the soldiers that were disappearing.
k_p58: Ritsuka : And from the looks of it, the Servant must be someone from Rome.
k_p58_note: Ritsuka figured as it made logical sense.
k_p59: Sora : If we want to find out what’s going on, I think we should talk to Emperor Nero. He should be in the capital right?
k_p61: Olga : [That woman must be the general of Nero’s army, so she may have ties to him. Before I forget, Fujimaru, Mash, make sure Sora keeps his mouth shut about you three coming from the future when you meet him.]
k_p62: Sora looked shocked that he was being called out like that as he pointed at himself.
k_p63: Sora : Huh!? Why am I being called out?
k_p63_note: Olga’s holographic image appeared in front of his face as she gave him a flat stare.
k_p64: Olga : [Because after knowing you for two weeks, I can tell you don’t care much about the world order and just blurt out whatever comes to mind.]
k_p65: Sora was about to argue against that but then paused and thought about it the past few times he nearly broke the rule. He scratched the back of his head and looked sheepishly at her. Ritsuka and Mash both chuckled at their friend’s response. Olga found no humor in that.
k_p66_note: They looked and saw the woman waving her hands at them as the men and chariots began to leave. She held her hand out to them as an offer.
k_p67: ??? : Come! The city awaits us! Let me show what we fought to protect with our lives.
k_p68: Olga : [Remember, don’t speak about the future.]
k_p68_note: Olga reminded them, though she glared at Sora specifically, getting him to nod in agreement while holding his hands up. Satisfied, the hologram disappeared just as the trio joined up with the woman and her army.
k_p69: ??? : By the way, forgive me for not asking earlier, but what are your names?
k_p71_note: Ritsuka introduced himself with a nod.
k_p72: Mash : I’m Mash Kyrielight. It’s nice to meet you.
k_p74: ??? : Umu! Such foreign names indeed! Now it’s my time!
k_p74_note: She gracefully spun around as a spotlight shined above her.
k_p75: ??? : I am—the true protector of Rome. Truly, I am Rome itself.
k_p75_note: She raised her hand and looked to the sky as crimson roses somehow appeared falling around her.
k_p76: ??? : The very day I took over the throne was the day I swore to rebuild the empire that had fallen from grace. Yes, this I swore to the gods, my ancestors, to myself, and to the people whom I love dearly!
k_p77: She spun around again, this time facing her newly formed friends with a happy yet also determined smile. She placed her hands on her chest and held the other out towards them.
